# pushing_pixels — cloud=1 controls for dpq3c (EVAL ONLY, no training).
#
# A cloud of one leaves the critic nothing to rank, so this measures the
# diffusion actor alone. Across both pixel environments that number matched
# or beat the full-cloud one (0.834 vs 0.819 paired, better on 12 of 18),
# and the best result in the project is dpq3c with the critic off. Treat it
# as the primary number, not the control.
#
# Generated by scripts/make_cloud1_batch.py from
# results/hyperparam_search/dpq3c_training/pushing_pixels/trials.jsonl — 29 training runs still need one
# (4 already scored at cloud=1).
